blocks.html: Now such things cannot fall within an instruction given him by another; for one may well teach certain speeches, and give tokens and marks: but to impart the knowledge of so many and so many divers persons, never seen or known — that is impossible, otherwise than by Magic or some reprobate art. And so much for the matter of the proof by witnesses. In the second place, a summary inquiry having been made upon the likeness of the accused with the sisters of Martin Guerre, it is reported — and better still by several witnesses heard in the inquiries on the court's own motion — that eggs are not more alike among themselves.
